notes.title: ++ UPDATE ++ "2 MONTHS AFTER RELEASE" CELEBRATION / DISCOUNT AND FREE COPIES ++
notes.content:
ON THE 23th OF AUGUST, WE CELEBRATE 2 MONTHS AFTER THE RELEASE OF KABUKI FIRE, THE ARCADE-STYLE ACTION GAME BY ATMOSPHERE ENTERTAINMENT STUDIOS. GAMERS THAT ARE CURIOUS ABOUT THE GAME, BUT HAVEN'T MADE THE TRIP TO BLACK ISLAND YET, WILL HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO BUY A COPY ON A DISCOUNT, STARTING FROM AUGUST 27TH!!



ADDITIONALLY WE ARE GIVING AWAY 10 FREE COPIES!!



WHAT DO YOU HAVE TO DO? JUST SEND AN EMPTY EMAIL WITH "I WANT A FREE COPY" IN THE

SUBJECT LINE TO INFO@KABUKIFIRE.COM UNTIL AUGUST 23TH!!



FROM ALL PARTICIPANTS, 10 WILL BE PICKED RANDOMLY AND A FREE STEAM-KEY WILL BE SEND

TO THEM!!



GOOD LUCK!!



++ UPDATE ++

THANK YOU TO ALL PARTICIPANTS IN THE "I WANT A FREE COPY" EMAIL-EVENT!! WE DECIDED TO GIFT A FREE COPY TO EVERYONE WHO PARTICIPATED!! ENJOY THE GAME AND SEE YOU IN THE ARENA!!
